entry_quality_regime_relax._comment: ENTRY-Q-REGIME-RELAX (2026-05-13). Per-regime list of entry_quality bands that are normally hard-blocked from BUY but ALLOWED here. Evidence: scripts/regime_sharpe_decomp.py output on n=897 trades — MISSED PF 2.59 / Sharpe +0.33 / n=302, EXTENDED PF 1.33 / Sharpe +0.10 / n=335. PULLBACK (n=72) is only PF 0.88 — gate is currently inverted. Relax in risk_on_choppy only (where bulk of profitable trades live). Empty/missing = legacy hard-block behavior preserved.

risk_on_choppy.mechanism: In choppy markets the scanner catches stocks AFTER they've already moved (EXTENDED/MISSED labels) but the trade still works — momentum continuation in mean-reverting regime where prior buyers are validated. PULLBACK (the gate's preferred state) in choppy underperforms because pullbacks in choppy often turn into continued pullbacks.

Trading-leaders profile still overrides to 82 in live; this affects baseline + backtest path. Originally was 80 (2026-05-08 recalibration), 65 (2026-05-10 CONFIG-1 restore), now 72 evidence-based.

rolling_sharpe_kill._note: ROLLING-SHARPE KILL (2026-05-13, Direction 2). Capital preservation gate. When the last N closed BUYs show rolling Sharpe < min_sharpe, pause new BUYs until edge returns. Truncates left-tail bad periods — the mechanism per the article's 'consistent Sharpe across regimes' bar. Roll back: set _enabled=false.
rolling_sharpe_kill._mechanism: Computes Sharpe-per-trade on the last lookback_n closed BUYs (filtering |pnl|<=100% outliers and requiring min_sample_n samples to fire). When Sharpe falls below threshold, the gate fires PRE-cascade and routes all candidates to WATCH. Self-clears when next closed BUY pushes rolling Sharpe back above threshold.

current_state_2026-05-13.expected_range: well-functioning system: Sharpe +0.1 to +0.5 per trade. Sharpe < -0.5 indicates ~5 consecutive losses or ~10 mixed with significant negative skew.

defensive_rotation_sleeve._note: DEFENSIVE-ROTATION sleeve — closes the bear-regime gap in Choice C (docs/strategy_defensive_rotation.md). Long defensive ETFs/large-caps when SPY < 50EMA + breadth deteriorating. ENABLED 2026-05-14 dormant — double-gated (regime AND SPY-50EMA) so cannot fire until qualifying conditions emerge.
defensive_rotation_sleeve._phase: PAPER (when enabled, signals emit as setup_family='Defensive Rotation' with WATCH_DEFENSIVE verdict; no live trades unless promoted via decision_engine).

_validations.mechanism: Institutional flight-to-safety flow: low-beta defensive sectors outperform 5-15% over 10-30d when SPY breaks 50EMA + breadth deteriorates. Federal Reserve flow data + CRSP returns support.

esp_play_sleeve._note: EARNINGS ESP PLAY — closes P0 roadmap item. Zacks ESP > 0 + Rank <= 3 + earnings within 4-14d = ~70% beat rate. Mode A (default): pre-earnings drift only, exit day before report. Mode B: ride through. Default Mode A for $5K account safety.

_validations.mechanism: Zacks Earnings ESP — Most recent EPS estimate vs consensus. ESP > 0 = positive recency skew = ~70% beat rate (Zacks: 25 years, 100K reports). Strongest when combined with Rank <= 3 (analyst alignment).

insider_cluster_sleeve._note: INSIDER-CLUSTER sleeve — promotes tier1 insider-cluster signal to its own setup_family with sizing/stops/hold. Mechanism: information asymmetry (Bettis-Coles-Lemmon 2000). 3+ insider purchases $200K+ within 30d → 8-15% drift over 30-60d. Reuses existing tier1_signals.insider_cluster detector.

_validations.mechanism: Information asymmetry: insiders trade on material non-public info despite fiduciary duty; multi-insider clusters with size threshold filter out routine grants. 60-65% beat-market rate historically. Bettis-Coles-Lemmon 2000, Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski 2012.

pead_sleeve._note: PEAD sleeve — most-documented anomaly in academic finance. Buy stocks 1-3d post-earnings-beat with positive revisions; drift 5-15% over 30-60d. ENABLED 2026-05-14 — fires in ALL regimes (catalyst is regime-independent). docs/strategy_pead.md.
pead_sleeve._phase: PAPER (signals emit as setup_family='PEAD' with WATCH_PEAD verdict; promote via decision_engine).
pead_sleeve._note_optional_gates: revenue_surprise and analyst_revisions gates disabled by default (data not yet plumbed). EPS surprise + gap-up cover Bernard-Thomas 1989 core mechanism. Raise these later if reverse-engineering analyst revisions or wiring revenue data.
pead_sleeve._min_score_note: Lowered 55→40 2026-05-14 — Bernard-Thomas mechanism is catalyst-driven, not score-driven. CEG/ZBRA had real PEAD setups (EPS +21%/+15%, gap +3.8%/+14.7%) but composite scores were 31/45 due to weak post-spike technicals. Catalyst overrides technical weakness.

_validations.mechanism: Post-earnings announcement drift: market under-reacts to earnings information; institutional analysts revise on 4-8w cycle. Bernard-Thomas 1989, Ball-Brown 1968, Foster-Olsen-Shevlin 1984, Chordia-Shivakumar 2006. Most-documented anomaly in academic finance.

mean_reversion_sleeve._note: MEAN-REVERSION sleeve — closes the choppy-alt diversifier gap (docs/strategy_mean_reversion.md). Buy oversold (RSI<30) with EMA200 floor in choppy/bull regime. ENABLED 2026-05-14 — will fire in current regime; mechanism is short-term reversal (Jegadeesh 1990).
mean_reversion_sleeve._phase: PAPER (signals emit as setup_family='Mean Reversion' with WATCH_MEANREV verdict; promote via decision_engine after observation).

_validations.mechanism: Statistical short-term reversal — RSI<30 in choppy regime with EMA200 floor signals emotional/forced selling not fundamental damage. Liquidity providers earn premium. Jegadeesh 1990, Lehmann 1990, Conrad-Kaul 1989.

momentum_sleeve._note: MOMENTUM-CONTINUATION sleeve — addresses trending-regime weakness (PF 1.00, n=266 in clean-data). Designed 2026-05-13 (docs/strategy_momentum_continuation.md). Default OFF — flip to true after Phase 1 paper validation passes (≥10 signals, hypothetical PF ≥1.5).
momentum_sleeve._phase: PAPER (signals emit as setup_family='Momentum Continuation' with WATCH_MOMENTUM verdict; no live trades). Promote to LIVE_HALF (verdict=BUY at 50% of designed size) after pass criteria met. Promote to LIVE_FULL after 21-30d half-size validation.

baseline_vs_V4_v1_proxy_breadth.note: v1 proxy systematically under-counted breadth; v2 real numbers are more honest.

_validations.interpretation: Long-eligible 10d WR ceiling is ~61% LB across all variants and both breadth sources. Regime classifier can't move WR past this — setup-level work needed (deferred per user 2026-05-10). V4's two real wins are: 2-bar SPY/EMA50 cuts whipsaws -38% (real-breadth backtest), loose-trending raises trend-day reachability 1.5x. Both pass Wilson floor (LB ≥ 40, n past 30).
_validations.mechanism: 2-bar SPY/EMA50: single close is noise (intraday wick / news gap); two consecutive closes confirms break. VIX<20 + breadth>60 (vs 18/65): the original 'perfect bull' gate fires too rarely on real breadth in 2024-26 to estimate WR with confidence.
open_caveats: Survivorship: real-breadth backtest uses CURRENT SP500 constituents against historical prices (principle 6). Wikipedia point-in-time membership is deferred (audit #1 Tier 2).

10-Week Pullback.note: Highest WR setup. n=87 / WR 73.6% / Wilson LB 63.4% / avg +4.25%. HIGH-EDGE — promote.

EMA21 Pullback.note: Worst setup by far. n=59 / WR 11.9% / Wilson LB 5.9% / avg -2.10%. KEEP KILLED.

bull.reason_kill: PF 0.55, accounts for 79.5% of all backtest losses; late entries in extended bull get whipsawed.
PF 0.08 over n=13 in F1+F2 — only 2 of 13 winners, avg_win 1.15% way below avg_loss -2.66%. Directionally unambiguous; n=13 < formal 30 floor.
PF 0.16 over n=10 — 1 of 10 winners. Even with avg_win 4.15% (decent), the WR is so low that PF is catastrophic.
PF 0.00 — ZERO winners in 8 trades. Strongest single-setup kill signal in the data. n=8 small but unambiguous.

setup_family_kill_by_regime._comment: 2026-05-13 — family-level regime kill, complements setup_score_multiplier_by_regime (which keys on raw plan.setup_type). Operates on classified setup_family (Breakout Expansion / Trend Continuation / Impulse Catalyst / Special Situation). Evidence base: scripts/regime_sharpe_decomp.py output, 2026-05-13 — stratification of 897 closed trades across picks_history + signal_log.

bull.reason_kill: Breakout Expansion family in bull regime shows negative-expectancy (PF 0.71, Sharpe -0.13). Wilson LB 28.5% well below 50% bar. Same family in choppy is profitable (n=233, PF 1.66, Sharpe +0.17) — issue is regime-specific, NOT setup-family-specific. Family-level kill complements per-setup_type kills above (those didn't cover VCP Breakout in bull which contributes to the 105 sample).
bull.mechanism: Breakouts in sustained trending markets tend to be already-priced-in by the time the scanner catches them. The 'breakout' has happened; we're chasing. In choppy markets, breakouts mark genuine accumulation that the scanner CAN catch early.
